description: LAPS Gold Standard Evaluation Corpus - 100 code-mixed Hinglish sentences with human token-level preservation labels
annotation_provenance_note: Inter-annotator agreement was measured across 2 independent bilingual raters on 90 candidate tokens across sentences S001-S020 (data/evaluation/annotations.csv). Observed agreement was 85/90 (94.44%), yielding Fleiss' kappa = 0.8739 and Cohen's kappa = 0.8744 ('Almost Perfect Agreement'). 5 disagreements (submit, postpone, free, raise, try; rater_1=1, rater_2=0) are preserved in the raw CSV with no synthetic final_consensus column; for gold evaluation labels, preservation was assigned according to the primary annotator's verified domain criteria.
